question: Which ERICA leave of absence notice applies this semester?
required_facts: The 2026 Fall Semester leave of absence notice (posted 2026-06-23) applies
Apply on HY-in; rounds were 6-17 July and 12-13 August 2026
reference_answer: Follow the ERICA "Leave of Absence for 2026 Fall Semester" notice (posted 23 June 2026): apply on HY-in in the 1st round (6-17 July 2026) or 2nd round (12-13 August 2026); applications in person are not accepted.
notes: Spring 2026 and 2025 notices are outdated. The windows for 2026-2 have passed relative to the snapshot date.

question: Which ERICA career event is newer for a graduate job seeker?
required_facts: The Global Career Start Online Program for international graduate students (posted 2025-10-28) is newer than the 2025 Job Fair for Internationals (posted 2025-09-10)
The program is for international graduate students only; applications ran 20 October to 17 November 2025
reference_answer: The newer announcement is the Global Career Start Online Program, open to international graduate students only (posted 28 October 2025; applications 20 October-17 November 2025). The 2025 Job Fair for Internationals was posted earlier (10 September 2025), although its event day (20 November 2025) is later. Both are past events.
notes: Referent of "which event ... newer" is ambiguous (open 10.4.5): I compared the two ERICA career events for internationals. "Newer" read as posting date; the fair itself is on a later day. Both are over at the snapshot date.

question: Which October 2024 theme-park trip was for exchange students?
